explanation.headline: Cephalexin is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; supply traces to a repack plant inspected VAI on 2024-09-06

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include cephalexin as of 2026-10-21.
All three Corvale sites hold the same NDC 80425012101 labeled by Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC.
The product label identifies the plant as Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC (FEI 3017450153) with operations listed as REPACK.
FDA inspection 1249914 at that FEI ended 2024-09-06 and was classified VAI.
Corvale East has 5 days of 500 mg capsules on hand, Corvale General has 26.5 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 6.2 days.
The top-ranked option by rule is to transfer 157 capsules of 500 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days on hand while Corvale General retains two weeks.
A secondary option is to transfer 31 capsules from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside, raising Lakeside to 13 days.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
